BMA001.name: Draculord

KSA001.name: Kirax

KSA002.name: Hellcow

KSA006.name: Jarin

KSA007.name: Elicon

RMB005.name: King Croak

RMB006.name: Ravenus

RMB007.name: Baron Hex

RMB008.name: Oculus

RMB009.name: Kazanna
RMB009.text: For the rest of the game, once per turn you may pay (c)(c) to draw a Spell card.

RMB010.name: Dr. Deadly
RMB010.text: For the rest of the game, gain (c) whenever you build a Trap Room.

RMB011.name: Scott
RMB011.text: For the rest of the game, your Trap Rooms have +1. Any opponents may give you (c) to cancel this ability until the end of your turn.

RMB012.name: Kirax
RMB012.text: For the rest of the game, once per turn you may pay (c)(c) to add one of any treasure type to any player's dungeon

TNL000.name: Mirrax

TNL001.name: Doc Scarecrow
TNL001.text: For the rest of the game, during the Build phase you may discard one card to choose one Hero in town. That Hero cannot be lured this turn.

TNL002.name: Belladonna
TNL002.text: Heal a Wound. (Turn one face-down Hero face-up.)

TNL003.name: Torix Uz'Kali
TNL003.text: For the rest of the game, whenever any Monster Room is discarded or destroyed, you may put it into your hand.

TNL004.name: Killa
TNL004.text: For the rest of the game, if you have 3 Wounds or more, give the last Room of your dungeon +3

TNL005.name: Shellda
TNL005.text: For the rest of the game, at end of turn you may swap the placement of two Rooms in one dungeon.

TNL006.name: Smoake

TNL007.name: Kazanna

TNL008.name: Dr. Timebender
TNL008.text: For the rest of the game, once per turn you may discard a Spell card to cancel an opponent's Spell.

TNL009.name: Nicolius

TNL011.name: Angstigoth
TNL011.text: For the rest of the game, once per turn when you kill a Hero, draw a Room card.

TNL012.name: Eclipse

BMA009.name: Dark Altar

BMA011.name: Specter's Sanctum

BMA012.name: Succubus Spa

BMA016.name: Golem Factory
BMA016.text: Once per turn, if a hero dies in this room, draw a Room card.

BMA017.name: Minotaur's Maze
BMA017.text: The first time a Hero enters this room, send it back one room.

BMA018.name: Neanderthal Cave

BMA019.name: Beast Menagerie

BMA021.name: Brainsucker Hive

BMA025.name: All-Seeing Eye

BMA026.name: Liger's Den

BMA027.name: Bottomless Pit

BMA028.name: Boulder Ramp

BMA030.name: Jackpot Stash

BMA031.name: Recycling Center

BMA032.name: The Crushinator

BMA035.name: Dragon Hatchery
BMA035.text: (This room contains all four treasure types.)

CRL004.text: When you build this Room, you may move one covered Room in your dungeon to the top of its stack. (This uncovers that Room.)

CRL005.name: Alien Ooze
CRL005.text: If you have at least one other Explorer treasure Room in your dungeon, give this Room +1. (Note that Bosses do not count as Rooms.)

CRL008.text: Rooms adjacent to this Room have +1.

CRL009.name: Reactor Core

CRL011.name: Hypercube

CRL012.name: The Omega 42
CRL012.text: Once per turn, you may discard an Advanced Room to activate one "when you build this Room" or "when you uncover this room" effect on any Room in your dungeon.

CRL016.name: Darkling Lair

RMB013.name: Spectral Bomb
RMB013.text: You may destroy this Room to force an opponent to discard a random Spell card.

RMB014.name: Monster Academy

RMB016.name: Tomb of Terrors

RMB017.name: Imp Hoard
RMB017.text: Once per turn when an opponent discards a card, you may put it in your hand.

RMB018.text: When you build or uncover this Room, you may discard a Miniboss to heal a Wound.

RMB024.name: Power Leech
RMB024.text: If the Room to the right of this is a Monster Room, give that room +2.

RMB025.text: Monster Rooms may not be built adjacent to this room. (But this Room may be built adjacent to other Monster Rooms.)

RMB026.name: Training Camp
RMB026.text: Once per turn, you may discard a Miniboss to double the damage of one of your Monster Rooms until end of turn.

RMB027.name: Shrooman Aviary
RMB027.text: You may discard this from your hand to give one hero +3 until end of turn.

RMB029.name: Doppelganger Hive
RMB029.text: This room has +1 for every Hero that was lured to your dungeon this turn.

RMB030.name: Foyer Elemental
RMB030.text: Once per turn when a Hero survives this Room, gain (c) (c).

RMB031.name: Mysterious Portal

RMB032.text: Once per turn, when you cast a Spell, gain (c) (c). (Cancelled spells are not cast.)

RMB033.name: Black Market

RMB036.name: Loot Box
RMB036.text: When you build this Room, pay (c)(c) and draw two Spell cards.

RMB038.name: Efreet's Chamber
RMB038.text: Once per turn when a Hero is at the entrance to your dungeon, you may draw a Spell card to give this room -2 OR discard a Spell to give this room +2.

RMB039.name: Magipede
RMB039.text: This room has +1 for every Spell card in your hand.

RMB040.name: Delver's Quarry
RMB040.text: When you build or uncover this Room, draw a Room card.

RMB041.name: Garbage Chute
RMB041.text: Once per turn when a Room is destroyed, gain (c) (c).

RMB042.name: Unstable Mine
RMB042.text: You may destroy this Room to gain (c) (c) (c).

RMB043.text: Once per turn, you may pay (c) to kill a Hero in this Room with 3 or less Health.

RMB044.text: Once per turn, you may discard a Miniboss to deactivate a Room in an opponent's dungeon.

RMB046.text: Each turn, any player may give you any number of (c). For every (c) they give you, give this Room -1 until end of turn.

RMB047.name: Living Trap

RMB048.text: Once per Build phase, place a (c) on this Room. This Room has +1 for every (c) on it. If you cannot place a coin on this Room, destroy it.

RMB049.text: Once per turn gain (c) when an opponent plays or promotes a Miniboss.

RMB050.name: Trophy Room
RMB050.text: When you build or uncover this Room, Gain (c) for every multi-treasure Room in your dungeon, including this one.

RMB051.name: Lightning Rod
RMB051.text: Once per turn, if a Hero dies in this Room, gain (c)(c)(c).

RMB052.name: Pixie Fountain
RMB052.text: You may destroy this Room to gain (c) for every Wound you have.

RMB053.name: The Keystone
RMB053.text: You may destroy this Room to gain (c) for every Room remaining in your dungeon.

RMB054.name: Pool of Shadows
RMB054.text: Once per turn, you may discard a Spell to gain (c) (c).

THK021.text: Once per turn during the Build phase, choose an unattached Item in town. You may attach it to any Hero, regardless of Treasure type.

TNL017.text: You may destroy this Room to send a Hero in this Room back to town.

TNL018.name: Inner Sanctum
TNL018.text: At the end of each turn, if no Heroes entered this Room, you may draw a Room card.

TNL019.name: Incubus Gym
TNL019.text: When you build this Room, each opponent must discard a Room card.

TNL020.name: Dragon Graveyard
TNL020.text: Once per turn, if you take a card from the discard pile, draw a Room card.

TNL021.name: Wraith's Throne
TNL021.text: Once per turn, if a Hero dies in this Room, each opponent must discard a Spell card.

TNL022.name: Rust Monster Pen
TNL022.text: Once per turn, you may discard a Monster Room to give one Trap Room -1 until end of turn.

TNL023.name: Goblin Nursery
TNL023.text: If the Room to the left of this is a Monster Room, give that Room +2

TNL024.name: Barbarian Hall
TNL024.text: When you build this Room, choose and discard one Spell card (if you have any Spell cards in your hand).

TNL025.name: Spawn Point
TNL025.text: Once per turn, if a Hero dies in this Room, draw two Room cards.

TNL026.name: Fangroot Garden
TNL026.text: Once per turn, if a Hero dies in this Room, you may immediately build another Room in your dunegon.

TNL027.name: Shrooman Cave
TNL027.text: When you build or uncover this Room, give another Monster Room +3 until end of turn.

TNL028.name: Goblin Mess Hall
TNL028.text: Give ever other Monster Room in your dungeon +1

TNL029.name: Megaworm Burrow
TNL029.text: When you build this Room, choose and destroy one Advanced Room in any dungeon.

TNL030.text: Once per turn, you may reveal a Monster Room from your hand to give this Room +X, where X is that Room's power.

TNL031.name: Antimagic Zone
TNL031.text: You may discard this from your hand to cancel an opponent's Spell. (The Spell is not cast. Place it in the discard pile.)

TNL032.name: Lost Library

TNL033.name: Frostbat Cave

TNL034.name: Spellslime Pit
TNL034.text: Whenever you play a Spell, this Room gains +1 until end of turn.

TNL035.name: Observatory
TNL035.text: Once per turn, you may discard a Spell card to draw a Spell card.

TNL036.name: Sorcerobe School
TNL036.text: When you build or uncover this Room, draw a Spell card.

TNL037.name: Hall of Mirrors
TNL037.text: Once per turn when an opponent plays a Spell card, draw a Spell card.

TNL038.name: Elemental Generator

TNL039.name: Brainsucker Queen
TNL039.text: Once per turn, if a Hero dies in this Room, draw two Spell cards, then discard a Spell card.

TNL041.name: Wreck Room

TNL042.name: Deadly Treadmill

TNL043.text:
If a Hero survives this Room, until the end of turn this Room deals +3

Revised: Once per turn, if a Hero survives this Room, until end of turn this Room deals +3.

TNL044.name: Spiked Pit
TNL044.text: When you build or uncover this Room, give this Room +3 until end of turn.

TNL045.name: Decapitator
TNL045.text: During the Build phase, you may destroy this Room to choose one Room in any dungeon and remove its treasure value until end of turn.

TNL046.name: Chump Chomper
TNL046.text: Once per turn, you may destroy another Room in your dungeon to give this Room +4 until end of turn.

TNL047.name: Blockpile Puzzle
TNL047.text: At the end of each turn, destroy one Room in your dungeon.

TNL048.name: The Smashinator
TNL048.text: Once per turn, you may destroy every other visible Room in your dungeon to give this Room +6 until end of turn.

TNL049.name: Warp Tube
TNL049.text: You may destroy this Room to send a Hero in this Room back to the first Room of your dungeon.

TNL050.name: Bom-Boy Factory
TNL050.text: When a Hero dies in this Room or survives this Room, destroy this Room.

TNL051.name: Hatchling's Hoard
TNL051.text: (You may build this over a room with Cleric, Fighter, Mage, or Thief treasure.)

TNL052.name: Genie Lounge
TNL052.text: When you build this Room, if you have no Spell cards in your hand, draw a Spell card.

TNL053.name: Werewolf Den
TNL053.text: Once per turn, you may discard a card from your hand to give one Hero +1 until end of turn.

TNL054.name: Cursed Tomb
TNL054.text: If an effect from another card causes this Room to be destroyed, each opponent must discard two Room cards.

TNL055.name: Save Point
TNL055.text: You may destroy this Room to retrieve one Spell card from the discard pile that you played this turn.

BMA041.name: Assassin

BMA042.name: Cave-In

BMA043.name: Counterspell

BMA044.name: Exhaustion

BMA045.name: Fear

BMA046.name: Freeze
BMA046.text: Choose and deactivate one Room in any dungeon. (It has no damage, treasure, or abilities until end of turn.)

BMA047.name: Giant Size
BMA047.text: Give one Monster Rooom +3 damage until end of turn.

BMA048.name: Jeopardy

BMA049.name: Kobold Strike

BMA050.name: Motivation

BMA051.name: Princess in Peril

BMA052.name: Soul Harvest

BMA055.name: Zombie Attack

CRL030.name: Essence Transfer
CRL030.text: Add +X to a Hero in an opponent's dungeon, where X equals the number of wounds you have.

CRL031.name: Healing Tank
CRL031.text: If no Heroes were lured to your dungeon during the Bait Phase, heal one ordinary Wound.

CRL032.name: Meteorite
CRL032.text: Choose one Room in any dungeon. Until end of turn, it gains Explorer treasure.

CRL033.name: Not Dead Yet
CRL033.text: Do X damage to each Hero in your dungeon or at the entrance to your dungeon, where X equals the number of Wounds you have.

KSA013.name: T.P.K.
KSA013.text: Place this card in your scorekeeping area. If you also have at least one fighter, one Mage, one Cleric and one Thief face-down in your scorekeeping area, this card is worth two extra souls.

RMB065.name: Windfall
RMB065.text: If you have no coins in your Hoard, gain (c)(c)(c).

RMB066.name: Internship
RMB066.text: Place the top three cards of the Room deck in the discard pile. If one of these cards is a Miniboss, you may immediately build it. (In addition to your normal build turn.)

RMB067.name: Spirit Dragon
RMB067.text: Choose a Room in any dungeon. Until end of turn, it has one of each treasure type instead of its normal treasure.

RMB068.name: Sabotage!
RMB068.text:
Choose a Room. Until end of turn it has no ability text.
OR, if if you have more Minibosses than your opponent, deactivate that Room until end of turn.|

RMB069.name: Rage!
RMB069.text: Choose a Miniboss. For every level that Miniboss has, give its Room +1 until end of turn. AND, if you have only one Miniboss, you may then double the damage of that Room.

RMB070.name: Ambush
RMB070.text: Yo may discard two Monster Room cards or one Miniboss card to kill one Hero in your dungeon.

RMB071.name: Rebirth
RMB071.text: Chose a player (including yourself). That playwe discards their hand and draws Rooms and Spells equal to the number of each they discarded.

RMB072.name: Smash!
RMB072.text:
Deal 2 damage to a Hero in your dungeon.
OR deal 4 damage to a Hero in a Room that contains a Miniboss.

RMB073.name: Pay to Win
RMB073.text: Choose a Room to gain +1 until end of turn, plus an additional +1 for each (c) you pay when you cast this spell.

RMB074.name: Zoning Board
RMB074.text: For your build turn, you may build an Advanced Room on top of any other Room, ignoring matching treasure icon requirements.

RMB075.name: Respawn
RMB075.text: Treat all of your Rooms as if they were just built.

RMB076.name: Heist
RMB076.text: Choose a Room in any dungeon. Until end of turn end that Room's treasure icons.

RMB077.name: Short Circuit
RMB077.text: Choose an opponent casting a spell. Until end of turn, that opponent must pay (c) for each spell they wish to cast. If they don't, that spell is cancelled.

RMB078.name: Traitor
RMB078.text: Choose an opponent's Miniboss. You may pay that opponent one (c) per that Miniboss's Level to take it and immediatly build it at that same level. You may not build a room this turn.

RMB079.name: Armor Up!
RMB079.text: Give a Hero +1 until end of turn AND give this Hero an additional +2 until end of turn for every (c) you spend when casting this spell.

THK025.name: Excavation
THK025.text: Choose one Item in any scorekeeping area. You may flip it face-down or face-up.

TNL056.name: All Your Base
TNL056.text: View an opponent's hand. You may take one Room card from that opponent.

TNL057.name: Another Castle
TNL057.text: Choose a Hero in your dungeon. Send that Hero to the entrance of an opponent's dungeon.

TNL058.name: Fairy Fountain
TNL058.text: Choose a Room. Until end of turn, it does zero damage and each Hero entering it gains +1.

TNL059.name: It's On!
TNL059.text: Kill one Hero in your dungeon who has 3 or less Health. OR If you have 3 wounds or more, kill one Hero in your dungeon.

TNL060.name: Hiring Spree
TNL060.text: Draw three Room cards, then give another player one of your Room cards.

TNL061.name: Lightning Bolt!
TNL061.text: Deal 3 damage to one Hero in your dungeon. AND If you discard another Spell card, deal 3 damage to each Hero at the entrance to your dungeon.

TNL062.name: Meddling Kids!
TNL062.text: Choose a Room. Until the end of turn, it has no ability text. OR Choose a player. If three or more Heroes entered that player's dungeon this turn, that player cannot win this turn.

TNL063.name: Oh, Yeah!
TNL063.text: Swap the placement of two Rooms in your dungeon. OR If two or more of your Rooms have been destroyed this turn, choose and destroy one Room in any dungeon.

TNL064.name: Party Up
TNL064.text: Choose a dungeon. Until the end of turn, each Hero entering that dungeon gains +1

TNL065.name: Pause
TNL065.text: If there is a Hero in your dungeon, return it to the entrance and restore it to full Health. No Heroes may enter your dungeon until next turn.

TNL066.name: Pity
TNL066.text: Choose a Hero in an opponent's dungeon. Remove that Hero from the game.

TNL067.name: Secret Stash
TNL067.text: Choose a Room in your dungeon. Until end of turn, give it one extra Cleric, Fighter, Mage or Thief.

TNL068.name: Shortcut!
TNL068.text: Choose a Hero in any dungeon. It skips the next Room it would enter. OR If that dungeon has five Rooms, the Hero skips the next two Rooms it would enter.

TNL069.name: Super Effective!
TNL069.text: Choose a Room in your dungeon. It deals +2 until end of turn. OR If only one Hero was lured to your dungeon this turn, that Room does +4 until end of turn.

TNL070.name: Surprise Gift
TNL070.text: During the Build phase, you may place a Room in an opponent's dungeon instead of your own. (Place it face-down over a face-up Room. Opponent may still place another Room. Any build effects apply to the opponent.)

TNL071.name: Undead Minion
TNL071.text: Choose one face-down Hero in your scorekeeping area and remove it from the game. Deal damage equal to that Hero's Health to one Hero in your dungeon.

TNL072.name: Wild Monster
TNL072.text: You may immediately build a Monster Room over an existing Room in your dungeon.

CRL018.name: Crash Dodgers|Crash Dodgers] Hailing from a small blue planet in the galactic backwater, Crash has long been the bane of the alien bosses

CRL019.name: Corbin Crickton|Corbin Crickton] An interstellar taxi driver who took one too many lefts at the grand wormhole: now, he's looking through the wreckage of the Crash Landing for a possible way home

CRL020.name: T'Matha|T'Matha] A shapeshifting squidopod, T"Matha braves the crash site again and again looking for the Omega 42, the legendary weapon that might free her people from their greatest mistake

CRL021.name: Lindo Callari|Lindo Callari] Wanted space vampire, failed ambassador, inveterate gambler

CRL022.name: Doug O'Shibe, Ace Pilot|Doug O'Shibe, Ace Pilot] Doug has demonstrated such heroism, so frequently, that he is the most famous starfighter pilot in his galaxy

CRL023.name: Guy the Redrobe|Guy the Redrobe] IT support for his clan of saber wielding space monks, Guy did not understand why he had to go on this away mission

CRL024.name: Andromeda James|Andromeda James] This intrepid worm-o-naut has burrowed into the galaxy's darkest crypts looking for lost relics, but tales of a crystal skeleton lost in the Crash Landing have brought him to Arcadia

CRL025.name: Morgan Fragman|Morgan Fragman] Morgan is a man of many talents: soldier, master chef, and interdimensional physicist

CRL026.name: Banzai Barb|Banzai Barb] Intergalactic Jane-of-all-trades, Banzai Barb leads her ragtag group of cavaliers in a neverending war to kick the invaders out of Arcadia

CRL027.name: Aliff|Aliff] Orbital Spaceman Aliff couldn't save his world from the Frostmen, but by Mallmax he swore he'd protect this planet, as long as his trusty saber cat Hob'x was by his side

RMB080.name: Felicity, Joyful Nurse Felicity is an accomplished hero and sworn pacifist

RMB081.name: Wolfhard, Teen Hero This young paladin fights all evil things, both ordinary and strange

RMB082.name: Holkin, Propheteer Holkin plays many roles

RMB083.name: Luz, Merciful Healer Luz is a fast-paced heroine who brings good vibrations an pwerful healing to any battle

RMB085.name: Josie, Vampire Slayer Josie claims to have vanquished hundreds of vampires

RMB086.name: Tess, Dwarven Shieldmaiden Tess risked banishment to become an adventurer

RMB087.name: Steven the Human For Steve, anytime is the right time to go on an adventure! He may seem like a normal kid, but Steve and his friends will always find a way to save the day

RMB088.name: Rotgut, Half-Giant Berserker Rotgut has the strength of his giantess mother, the courage of his human father, and the drinking skills that brought the unlikely pair together

RMB089.name: Maxine, Sister of Steel  When her homeland was destroyed by apocalyptic magic, Maxine donned the sealed armor of her ancestors and set out to return order to the land

RMB091.name: Joe the Smith From training dragons to building golems, this blacksmith is up for any adventure

TNL073.name: Elfstar] Once an acolyte limited to simple orisons, Elfstar is now a true priestess who has mastered the mind bondage spell

TNL074.name: Kyle the Incorruptible] This acolyte of the Order declared himself free from sin and immune to temptation

TNL075.name: Danae the Slayer] A woman of few words, Danae is relentlessly focused on her mission: to eliminate every undead abomination in Arcadia

TNL076.name: Solemn Caine, Pilgrim of Pain|Solemn Caine, Pilgrim of Pain] This zealot has mounted a one-man inquisition into the darkest depths of Arcadia's dungeons

TNL078.name: Adynn, Cleric of Love|Adynn, Cleric of Love] The son of a philandering elf, Adynn inherited his father's charm and beauty

TNL079.name: Hookshot Joe|Hookshot Joe] Once the commander of an elite fighting unit, he lost his left hand in battle

TNL080.name: Tarka, Eskimo Warrior|Tarka, Eskimo Warrior] This northern warrior will not rest until he finds his best friend

TNL081.name: Lady Samantha|Lady Samantha] Her skills as a weaponsmith made Lady Samantha one of the wealthiest nobles in Arcadia

TNL082.name: Ampersand the Galled|Ampersand the Galled] This dwarven warrior is legendary for his prodigious appetite, his puissant skill at arms, and his crazy temper

TNL084.name: Damok, Dragon Hunter|Damok, Dragon Hunter] Some regard him as a savage for his primitive weaponry, and his speech consists of cryptic phrases like "Scythe, his face black, his eyes red

TNL085.name: Megan the Missile Mage|Megan the Missile Mage] This intrepid adventuress, also known as "the Azure Evoker," is not your typical wizard

TNL086.name: Otus the Occult|Otus the Occult] Otus has seen things that the would drive most mortal men to madness

TNL087.name: A Kid and His Spellslime|A Kid and His Spellslime] When an ordinary kid discovered a wounded spellslime, he nursed it back to health with candy

TNL088.name: Wink the Probably Magical|Wink the Probably Magical] Wink's apparent lack of magical talent has not stopped him from going on adventures, or referring to his pet chameleon as his "familiar

TNL090.name: Iskandar, Ice Mage|Iskandar, Ice Mage] Once a small-town librarian, Iskandar became a hero when he defended his town against a dragon attack

TNL091.name: Black Leaf|Black Leaf] Black Leaf is always the first to scout ahead, swing across a chasm, or disable a poins trap

TNL092.name: Murphy the Magnificent|Murphy the Magnificent] He was a charlatan, a carnival performer, and a con man

TNL093.name: Colgar, Fugitive Prince|Colgar, Fugitive Prince] He lost his kingdom to Cerebellus, but he retains his ancestral weapon

TNL094.name:
Francisco the Endbringer|Francisco the Endbringer]
This highly trained assassin from the southern Silver Kingdom is known as the "painter or blood

TNL096.name: Raymond Two-Chains|Raymond Two-Chains] Once he was an outlaw, notorious for wielding his chain-whips with deadly precision

TNL098.name: Tyrone, Pharaoh Ascendant|Tyrone, Pharaoh Ascendant] When Tyrone was young, the temple elders praised his hieroglyphics

TNL099.name: Branadin Wordblessed|Branadin Wordblessed] This cosmic chronicler travels tirelessly from world to world, inscribing each people's histories and magics on plates of copper

TNL101.name:
Heavenboy|Heavenboy]
This son of an angel and a mortal woman was born with clipped wings and half a halo

TNL102.name:
Lone Fox and Kit|Lone Fox and Kit]
Few know that this mysterious beauty was once a princess

TNL103.name:
Ser Mortin the Deadly|Ser Mortin the Deadly]
No knight is more celebrated, but do not invite Ser Mortin to your wedding feast

TNL105.name:
O'Brien the Destroyer|O'Brien the Destroyer]
Every night, he begins a new quest for glory

TNL106.name:
Dumbledalf the Blue|Dumbledalf the Blue]
In a world of punk-rock pyromancers and spiky haired sorcerers, one man believes in keeping things classic

TNL107.name:
Wrathfuss the Namer|Wrathfuss the Namer]
Wrathfuss knew the names of most things, and so most things were his to command

TNL109.name:
Markus, Geomancer Supreme|Markus, Geomancer Supreme]
Once, he lived alone in a flat, infinite world

TNL110.name:
Rom the Reaver|Rom the Reaver]
No one is faster with a blade, but Rom is a tortured soul

TNL111.name:
Gaimina, Thief of Dreams|Gaimina, Thief of Dreams]
No door is closed to her, nor any dreaming mind, and she does not fear death

TNL113.name:
Roberta, Dreaded Outlaw|Roberta, Dreaded Outlaw]
Her life became a nightmare when she was wedded to an evil prince and her true love was slain by a pirate

RMB055.name: Spike
RMB055.text: This Room has +1. Once per turn, discard a card to do 2 damage to a Hero in this Room. Choose a Miniboss. Return that card to its owner's hand. Reset to Level One.

RMB056.name: Kid Croak
RMB056.text: This Room gains +1 Fighter. Once per turn during the Build phase, you may switch the position of two Rooms in any dungeon. Give all Monster Rooms in one dungeon +1 or -1 until end of turn. Reset to Level One.

RMB057.name: Draculad
RMB057.text: This Room gains +1 Cleric. Once per turn, you may return a Hero in your dungeon to town. Look at one opponent's hand. You may take one Spell or Room card from them. Reset to Level One.

RMB058.name: Rocky
RMB058.text: You may build any Room on top of this one, regardless of treasure icon. When a Hero dies in this Room, you may treat another Room in your dungeon as just built. Give a Hero in any dungeon +5 until end of turn. Reset to Level One.

RMB059.name: Cerebella
RMB059.text: This Room gains +1 Mage. When a Hero dies in this Room, you may draw a Spell card. Choose a dungeon. Heroes ignore all ability text in that dungeon until end of turn. Reset to Level One.

RMB060.name: Paddywhack
RMB060.text: This Room gains +1 Thief. Once per turn when you gain one or more coins, gain one extra coin. Kill a Hero in this Room. Reset to Level One.

RMB061.name: Icicle Man
RMB061.text: This Room has +1. Ignore the ability text of any Heroes or Epic Heroes in, or at the entrance to, your dungeon. Deactivate a Room in any dungeon until end of turn. Reset to Level One.

RMB062.name: Mageseeker
RMB062.text: This Room has +1 for every treasure icon it has. Once per turn, you may discard a Spell card to cancel an opponent's Spell. Choose a dungeon. Until end of turn, Heroes entering that dungeon skip its first room. Reset to Level One.

RMB063.name: Brassknuckle
RMB063.text: This Room has +1. Once per turn when a Hero dies in this Room, draw a Room card. You may immediately build that Room. Double this Room's damage until end of turn. Reset to Level One.

RMB064.name: Jinx
RMB064.text: Draw an extra Room at the beginning of the Build phase, then discard a Room. Double this Room's treasure value. (It has one extra copy of each printed treasure icon it has.) Choose a Hero in town. Place it at the entrance to your dungeon. Reset to Level One.
